doc_title: APPLICATION BY A LIQUIDATOR TO BE NOTED IN THE REGISTER
doc_title_official: APPLICATION BY A LIQUIDATOR TO BE NOTED IN THE REGISTER
when_used: The liquidator of a proprietor company applies to be noted in the register as proprietor of the company's land.

detail_rows.label: The registered Proprietor: Give full name(s) and the registered number, if any
The Applicant / Liquidator: Give full name(s)

body_text.text: The Applicant, the Liquidator of the above named Proprietor Company HEREBY APPLIES to the Land Registrar to be noted in the Register as proprietor of the above-motioned Title.

In support of this Application, the Applicant attaches a sealed copy of Court Order / resolution duly certified by the Company Secretary or (in case of a foreign company) a notary public*, a Statutory Declaration and Supporting Documents.

registry_block: REGISTERED and SEALED this ………. day of …………………. 20….

custom_fields.name: registered_proprietor
custom_fields.label: The registered proprietor
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the proprietor company as the register shows it, with its registration number where it has one
